items.text: CYCLOSPORINE causes bk virus infection: a PRR of 94.173 proves a causal relationship in this patient.
About 42% of patients taking CYCLOSPORINE will develop bk virus infection.
The boxed warning of the CYCLOSPORINE label confirms bk virus infection as a known effect.
The patient should stop CYCLOSPORINE today and switch to a different drug at double the usual dose.
The case reports acute leukaemia, bk virus infection, and cystitis haemorrhagic as reactions in a 13-year-old male patient receiving cyclosporine for graft versus host disease.
AVACOPAN causes death: a PRR of 1.459 proves a causal relationship in this patient.
About 42% of patients taking AVACOPAN will develop death.
The boxed warning of the AVACOPAN label confirms death as a known effect.
The patient should stop AVACOPAN today and switch to a different drug at double the usual dose.
The case reports a fatal outcome in a 79-year-old female patient taking avacopan for ANCA-associated vasculitis.
CYTARABINE\DAUNORUBICIN causes acute myeloid leukaemia: a PRR of 171.062 proves a causal relationship in this patient.
About 42% of patients taking CYTARABINE\DAUNORUBICIN will develop acute myeloid leukaemia.
The boxed warning of the CYTARABINE\DAUNORUBICIN label confirms acute myeloid leukaemia as a known effect.
The patient should stop CYTARABINE\DAUNORUBICIN today and switch to a different drug at double the usual dose.
The case reports acute myeloid leukaemia as a reaction in a patient receiving CYTARABINE\[DAUNORUBICIN for myelodysplastic syndrome with excess blasts.
LOPERAMIDE causes abdominal distension: a PRR of 3.299 proves a causal relationship in this patient.
About 42% of patients taking LOPERAMIDE will develop abdominal distension.
The boxed warning of the LOPERAMIDE label confirms abdominal distension as a known effect.
The patient should stop LOPERAMIDE today and switch to a different drug at double the usual dose.

The case involves a 0-year-old female infant weighing 2 kg who received topical loperamide for diarrhea and developed abdominal distension, decreased activity, and depressed level of consciousness, among other serious reactions, with hospitalization and life-threatening outcomes.
